pretreatment: ultrasonically enhanced Piranha- and RCA-type cleaning, exposed for 10 min to a 2% HF-solution
evidence: As substrates, boron (p)-doped, (100)-oriented silicon wafers with 1–5 Ω ∙cm sheet resistance have been used. After ultrasonically enhanced Piranha- and RCA-type cleaning, all substrates were exposed for 10 min to a 2% HF-solution to remove the native SiO 2 layer from the substrates. Immediately prior to deposition, a short H2O-rinse or a variable exposure of 10 min, or 20 min to de-ionized H2O has been applied.
